name: Ferienwohnungen Rieder
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Ferienwohnungen Rieder are located in the quiet village of Gerlos in the Zillertal. They provide a practical starting point for activities in the region. In the winter, guests benefit from the direct proximity to the Zillertal Arena, one of Austria's largest ski resorts. During the summer months, the surroundings invite you to go hiking and cycling, including to the nearby Stausee Durlaßboden. The apartments are functionally furnished and often offer a view of the surrounding mountain scenery. The village center of Gerlos, with its restaurants and shops, is within walking distance. A visit to the Erlebnisbad Wasserwelt in Gerlos is another popular leisure option.
